text:
alex: deploy-bot just blocked the publish for `redwood/backend:staging-v1.2.3` in eu-west-1 — provenance guard: manifestlist ordering mismatch. Seeing a checksum vs attestation mismatch in logs. anyone seen this pattern before?

deploy-bot: Automated: publish blocked for tag `staging-v1.2.3` (build 5012). Reason: provenance_manifest_mismatch. Affected regions: eu-west-1. Suggested action: human review / retag to known-good digest. Logs: `error: manifestlist order differs from attestation`

sam: Is this the cross-region mirror ordering bug we hit last quarter (arm64 vs amd64 ordering)?

jess: Logs show manifestlist created with amd64 first then arm64. Mirror/verifier in eu expects arm64-first for our attestation process, so signature check failed. publishbot attempted verification and flagged mismatch.

mike: quick lookup: `aws ecr describe-images --repo redwood/backend --image-ids imageTag=staging-v1.2.3 --region eu-west-1` returns digest `sha256:1111abcd...` but attestation references `sha256:aaaa1111...` (previous digest). So looks like a race where a later multiarch manifest was pushed after attestation was generated.

alex: Okay. We have the 16:00-17:00 UTC change window. Options: 1) retag previous digest (safe, fast), 2) re-run attestation against current manifest (longer), 3) manual promote and force bypass (not ideal). Thoughts?

jess: +1 retag previous digest to `staging-v1.2.3` in eu-west-1 and ensure attestation exists. That keeps provenance intact and minimizes blast radius. Update release notes to call out the pin.

sam: I'll open the release-note PR and pin the digest in the release manifest. Also will add a short rollback runbook.

deploy-bot: Proposed action: retag -> `staging-v1.2.3-retag-1811112222` created -> inject attestation -> promote to `staging-v1.2.3`. Requires manual approval by release owner.

alex: I'll approve. Sam, tag me in the PR and update the canary route in console once retag complete.

mike: Command to run (ops): ```bash
# retag digest to tag in eu-west-1
./tools/ecr-retag --repo redwood/backend --from-digest sha256:aaaa1111 --to-tag staging-v1.2.3 --region eu-west-1
```

sam: PR #894 opened: "Pin staging-v1.2.3 to previous digest in eu-west-1 + release notes". Assigned to @alex. Also added change-window note and rollback steps.

alex: Approved and merging. Triggering retag now. publishbot / deploy-bot - please report status.

publishbot: Retag started. Running provenance injection. ETA ~5m.

publishbot: Retag complete. Attestation injected and verified. `staging-v1.2.3` now points to `sha256:aaaa1111` in eu-west-1.

deploy-bot: Canary promotion scheduled for 10m from now. Routing set to pinned digest for canary hosts.

jess: I'll file a follow-up to fix manifestlist generator ordering — ticket INF-4321 created. We should add a unit test to lock arch ordering and add a gating check in CI for attestation parity.

sam: INF-4321 created and linked to PR. Adding a post-mortem bullet to the release notes.

alex: Summary / actions: retag to previous digest, update release notes and release manifest, schedule INF-4321 to fix generator ordering. If canary shows issues we'll roll back to pinned digest and open incident. Thanks, all. :thumbsup:

jess: small follow-up: add a note to ops runbook to avoid force-pushing new manifestlists during attestation window.

mike: noted. I've added an entry to the runbook.

alex: closing thread — monitoring canary for 30m.
